title: An available check and a current check with a pending debit, and the two mixed (decision I1)
story: Three made-up bank accounts, each opened on Fri 20 Nov 2026 with 300,000. On Sat 21 Nov each pays 10,000 by debit card; the bank posts it on Tue 24 Nov. On Sun 22 Nov a check is typed for each. Available: the bank app's 'available' figure, 290,000, which already has the pending debit taken off. Current: the bank's 'current' figure, 300,000, which does not have it yet. Mixed: the available figure 290,000 on the 22nd, then the current figure 300,000 on Mon 23 Nov. I1: an available check holds every event dated on or before its day; a current check follows the H1 posted-date rule; a check that does not say is current. No holidays are listed for this test. Every amount is made up.
